fibroblasts. An equivalent proportion of fibroblast peaks are closed in the xOSK state (Fig S8a).

and distal cis-regulatory elements that initiate a cascade of chromatin remodeling events and 
corresponding transcriptomic changes (Deng et al., 2021; Chronis et al., 2017; Knaupp et al.,

peak set to investigate their putative functional roles (Fig 4c, Table S2, Methods). To 
understand cis regulation of these dynamic peak sets, we quantified global TF motif activity

OC peaks are predicted to be regulated by AP-1, ATF, CEBP, RUNX, IRF1, NFI, and FOX
